Hero_Desc_DianaYester:
Diana of Yesteryear emerged from a book recording the past and came face to face with the present.
She retains the appearance and personality she had as a warrior of the Furball Tribe.
Her strength is immense, but speaking with her reveals an unexpectedly thoughtful nature.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_DianaYester: The Strongest in Her Glory Days
Album_Like_DianaYester: The languid calm of a quiet forest
Album_Hate_DianaYester: People who cling to her and demand one thing after another
Album_Wish_DianaYester: To live an easy, carefree life. To protect her precious friends.
Album_DianaYester1: Diana's younger days, once known only through legends and stories, burst into the world through the witches' hasty judgment. This Diana carries a very different air from the one we know and has a completely uninhibited personality.
Album_DianaYester2: She finds nearly everything bothersome and is highly guarded, but a sincere request can still persuade her rather than being rejected outright. Her fundamental nature seems little different from the Diana we know, though Diana of Yesteryear dislikes showing it.
Album_DianaYester3: The unwieldy, poorly balanced axe is said to be Diana of Yesteryear's signature weapon, but her true ability emerges in unarmed combat. Her strength rivals even Erpin, whose power is unmatched in the Sprite Kingdom. Judging by their experience and training, Diana of Yesteryear may be stronger.
Album_DianaYester4: At first, Diana of Yesteryear cared nothing for the circumstances around her. After hearing the history of the Werebeast Village, however, her feelings became complicated. She is confused, unsure what choice to make or how to act.
Album_DianaYester5: With her imposing horns, Diana of Yesteryear overwhelms her surroundings by merely appearing. Other Apostles and monsters take one look at her and quietly edge away. Tig is the sole exception, showing no fear at all.
Album_DianaYester6: Once we became familiar enough to speak, I learned that this Diana, who looks ready to solve everything with force, actually thinks deeply about many things. I cannot tell whether she was always this way or learned it while living in this new era.
Album_DianaYester7: Though she remains somewhat detached, Diana of Yesteryear seems to have accepted the Order and decided to work as an Apostle. She visits far more often and has grown close not only to her villagers but to Apostles of other races. Watching her strive not to repeat her future self's mistakes is strangely reassuring.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Hate1: She shook her head, saying the ingredients were expensive and the dish looked needlessly complicated. She would rather eat more of something else than have one of these.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Hate2: She grumbled that it looked like obvious junk food. Apparently, the old folks in her village always lectured her about it... This must be a story from Diana's youth.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like1: Diana broke into a broad smile when she saw the cartoon-style roast meat on the plate. For Diana of Yesteryear to smile like that, she must truly love it.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like2: Diana studied the knot bread from every angle for some time before eating it. Its distinctive shape seems to appeal to her.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like3: She said growing older did not seem to offer many advantages, yet she ate happily. The flavor itself must suit her exceptionally well.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like4: She ate with pleasure, saying its appearance conveyed the languid feeling of the forest. She looked remarkably relaxed.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like5: She nodded, saying it looked convenient to carry and eat while traveling. She seems to want some for training.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like6: After examining the songpyeon's colors and soft texture, she promptly tossed them into her mouth. She seems more interested in flavor and fullness than appearance.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like7: She clicked her tongue and warned that eating these constantly would rot every tooth, but her hand showed no intention of stopping. She must like them quite a bit.
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like8: She tossed it into her mouth and asked whether that was all. Should I hurry and make more...?
Food_ChefNote_DianaYester_Like9: Looking at the colorful shapes, she casually tossed them into her mouth and said flavor mattered more than appearance. It did not take her long to empty the entire container.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_DianaYester: I hate complicated things. Let us keep it simple.
Gacha_Result_Line1_DianaYester: Protect what matters to you until the very end.
DianaYester_Spawn1: I am already prepared to fight.
DianaYester_Spawn2: Haa~ What a nuisance. Let us finish quickly.
DianaYester_Growth1: There is no downside to getting stronger.
DianaYester_Growth2: If I want to take life easy, I have to get stronger.
DianaYester_Victory1: That was nothing. This much is easy.
DianaYester_Victory2: It feels good to use some strength again after so long.
DianaYester_Defeat1: Hmph. Now I have a reason to grow stronger.
DianaYester_Defeat2: This is irritating. Can I not have another round?
DianaYester_Affinity1_2: Do not make such a fuss over nothing.
DianaYester_Affinity2: What? What do you want me to do? Speak clearly.
DianaYester_Affinity3: This axe? You want to know how I swing it? You are prepared for this, right?
DianaYester_Affinity4: Hmm. The Werebeast Village these days feels a little... strange.
DianaYester_Affinity5: Hmm? My horns? Do not touch them. I take good care of these, you know.
DianaYester_Affinity6: Living in this world really is complicated. It is such a pain.
DianaYester_Affinity7: Well... I suppose this world as it is now is not bad. As long as it can accept me, that is.
DianaYester_Die1: Tch. Was I too relaxed about the fight?
DianaYester_Die2: You are saying I was not strong enough?
DianaYester_LevelUp: If you do not grow, someone will eventually look down on you.
DianaYester_Equipment: It is no match for my axe... but it is not bad.
DianaYester_HeroUpgrade: Only strength lets you protect what matters.
DianaYester_Board: Shall I go for a walk?
DianaYester_DeckSetting2: If we are fighting, let us get moving already.
DianaYester_Touch1: You have quite a vicious grip.
DianaYester_Touch1_1: You pulled with all your strength, did you not?
DianaYester_Touch2_1: Yes. This is the feeling I wanted.
DianaYester_Touch2: Ahem! Well... I will let it pass.
DianaYester_Touch2_2: This feeling... puts me at ease.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_DianaYester_Skin1: Strictly speaking, Diana of Yesteryear has no home or ties in this era, so joining the Order may be the natural choice. But does she have to take it quite this seriously?
DianaYester_Growth1_Skin1: No one can stand in my way.
DianaYester_Growth2_Skin1: Send anyone you like against me.
DianaYester_LevelUp_Skin1: Is there still room to climb higher?
DianaYester_Equipment_Skin1: This... looks like a useful tool.
DianaYester_HeroSkill_Skin1: It should prove useful once I master it.
DianaYester_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I will stand at the very top.
DianaYester_Board_Skin1: Is that today's worksite over there?
DianaYester_Touch1_Skin1: Are you committing insubordination right now?
DianaYester_Touch1_1_Skin1: Take it easy. You are undermining my dignity.
DianaYester_Touch1_2_Skin1: Just try touching the lenses of my glasses.
DianaYester_Touch2_Skin1: Even a boss needs time to rest.
DianaYester_Touch2_1_Skin1: It feels as though I have found somewhere my heart can rest.
DianaYester_Touch2_2_Skin1: I can trust you at my side.
DianaYester_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Stop before I call my subordinates!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_DianaYester_Skin2: Feeling almost like an outsider, Diana of Yesteryear discovered an unusual sense of kinship with Guin. She appears to have learned a new hobby from her.
DianaYester_Growth1_Skin2: Now I can cut through the waves.
DianaYester_Equipment_Skin2: Hmm, I hope it is better than going bare-handed.
DianaYester_HeroSkill_Skin2: Once you learn the trick, there is nothing to fear.
DianaYester_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Does this come with a license upgrade?
DianaYester_Board_Skin2: Move! I need to catch the current!
DianaYester_Touch1_1_Skin2: Your touch is as sharp as the sea breeze.
DianaYester_Touch1_2_Skin2: You know pinching sunburned skin hurts, right?
DianaYester_Touch2_Skin2: The surfing was good today, so I will let it pass.
DianaYester_Touch2_1_Skin2: I see you witnessed my brave display just now.
DianaYester_Touch2_2_Skin2: Praise feels unfamiliar, but I like it.
DianaYester_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Want me to hit you with this board?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_DianaYester_Skin3: Diana (Yester) after reaching the pinnacle of martial arts through long years of training. Her mighty roar becomes thunder and commands the heavens.
DianaYester_Growth1_Skin3: I feel as though I can still grow stronger.
DianaYester_Growth2_Skin3: They say training never ends. So it really is true.
DianaYester_LevelUp_Skin3: There are still greater heights to reach?
DianaYester_Equipment_Skin3: Will this one last a little longer?
DianaYester_HeroSkill_Skin3: I feel like I could smash anything I see.
DianaYester_Board_Skin3: Advance like the wind, yet stand firm as a mountain.
DianaYester_Touch1_Skin3: Are you fearless, or simply thoughtless?
DianaYester_Touch1_1_Skin3: Fine, fine. Do as you please.
DianaYester_Touch1_2_Skin3: Do not expect me to keep tolerating this.
DianaYester_Touch2_Skin3: Ugh, this is a little embarrassing in this form...
DianaYester_Touch2_1_Skin3: It still feels good. I can feel myself relaxing.
DianaYester_Touch2_2_Skin3: D-do not do this in front of the others! Understood?
DianaYester_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: Keep that up and lightning will strike you!
DianaYester_AsideGet: I wish things could always remain peaceful and easy, without anything happening.
DianaYester_AsideUpgrade: Shall I take a nap in the quiet forest?
DianaYester_Ultimate1: I will smash you to pieces!
DianaYester_Birthday: You must be in a good mood today. Want to have a meal together?
DianaYester_Gacha2: Protect what matters to you until the very end.
DianaYester_Gacha3: I hate complicated things. Let us keep it simple.
DianaYester_Line1: Shall I rest here for a while?
DianaYester_Line2: There are no strange characters nearby, right?
DianaYester_Lobby: Is there anywhere I can relax in peace?
DianaYester_StartJourney1: I said, stay out of my way.
DianaYester_StartJourney2: Move. You are in the way.
DianaYester_StartJourney3: Another request? I suppose it cannot be helped.
LoveLetter_DianaYester:
Master, it is me.

It feels like quite some time since I last heard news of you. Have you been well?
I will visit again soon. For another w-a-l-k, like last time.

Truthfully, this is the first time in my life anyone has helped me so much.
So... I do not really know how to repay you.

When you reply, write down something you want or something you like.
LoveCall_DianaYester:
Hmm, do I speak into this?
Master, it is Diana. You can tell which Diana from my voice alone, right?
This is my first time personally calling someone. It feels strangely unfamiliar.

As you know, I settled near the Sprite Kingdom and have been doing well. It is a nuisance, but sometimes I visit Village Chief Diana and help train the little ones. That I have adapted to this world so well... Yes, I suppose I owe it all to you.

Hmm, so... I have business near the Order tomorrow. If you have time, will you come out for a while? Bringing knot bread would be good too.
D-Do not misunderstand. It is not because I want to see you. I will simply be nearby and thought I might look at your face while I am there!

Ahem. In any case, I will see you tomorrow! If you are not prepared... you had better brace yourself.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP01_001: They have all sorts of things here.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP01_002: There are even boxed meals for training journeys.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP01_003: That sounds good. Can I order a month's worth? What? I have to order a week in advance?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP01_004: Is there anything you want to eat?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP01_005: Something I want to eat... Will you make anything I order? Hmm~ Then I shall give it some thought.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP01_006: It is nothing special! It is a Banquet Hall full of sweet things.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP01_007: ...Was that supposed to be a joke? For someone who calls themself the Master... your jokes are terribly poor.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP02_001: Tch. What a feeble lot. Who raised them that way...? What are you staring at?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP02_002: I agree. Let us work them harder.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP02_003: You speak my language. This is a schedule I used. What do you think? Follow this training plan and even you can become strong.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP02_005: Huh? The me of this world has grown soft. I would never have raised them that way.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP02_006: Perhaps you are simply too strong.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP02_007: Hmm. I am strong, that is true. That sounded rather like flattery... Why are you watching my reaction?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP03_001: Me, the village chief? I do not want to.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP03_003: What inspires such confidence? The me of this world must have done rather well. Hmm. There is little I cannot do, after all.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP03_004: Let us enjoy absolute power as village chief.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP03_005: Oh? That does sound tempting. Hehehe... What? Why are you looking at me as though something dreadful is about to happen?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP03_007: Huh? You claim there is something that does not suit me? Do not make me laugh. I shall become a finer village chief than anyone.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP04_001: That Tig is quite something. She has spirit. You might say she is satisfying to train.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP04_003: Huh? Anyone listening would think I was abusing her.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP04_004: Do not work her too hard.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP04_005: What does 'not too hard' mean? That attitude will never make anyone strong.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP04_006: That is because you taught her well.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP04_007: Ahem. Flattery will not get you anything. What is this? A fruit I picked up along the way. Eat it.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP05_001: When someone refuses to listen, a beating is the best medicine. What? The village-chief version of me never said such a thing? Impossible.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP05_002: Come to think of it, there was a club someone used all the time...
Affinity_DianaYester_EP05_003: A club? Good grief. Why use such a tool when you have fists? I cannot understand it.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP05_004: It is true. She beat people with her gaze.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP05_005: With her gaze? I see... Did she become capable of subduing an opponent through sheer force of presence?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP05_006: Perhaps she grew more patient with age?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP05_007: That I do not know. But I know this: she was probably beating them senseless in her mind.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP06_001: What sort of person was the village-chief version of me?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP06_003: Kind? Who was? Me? That is difficult to comprehend.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP06_005: That was strong? She looked terribly gaunt. I am curious what she normally looked like, though. Everyone said she was strong.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP06_007: She kept you well fed? Well, eating properly is certainly important for good health. What is that look for?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP07_001: I feel as though I have not trained enough lately... How about a sparring match?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP07_003: Not bad. I will use my full strength, so prepare yourself. You are not thinking of sneaking away, are you?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP07_005: For the Master who leads an entire Order to avoid a fight... How disappointing.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP07_006: Rather than a match, please instruct me.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP07_007: Understanding both your own ability and your opponent's is important, you know. Very well. I shall teach you how to fight properly.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP08_001: Sometimes Tig says things to me... but I am not her village chief.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP08_002: But to Tig, you are her one and only village chief.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP08_003: ...Hmph. If you think that will make me reduce the intensity of her training, you are mistaken.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP08_004: What sort of village chief has that attitude?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP08_005: I am not the village chief. I never said I would become one.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP08_006: But you seem to care about Tig.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP08_007: Seeing her keep up with my training is rather admirable. A tiger is still a tiger, after all. What is that look for?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP09_001: You need a balanced diet to have strength! Do not be picky!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP09_003: Sometimes you must endure and eat something even when you dislike it. I dislike it, but I endure and eat it.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP09_004: Exactly! We should punish every picky eater!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP09_005: Picky eaters? Are there others who refuse their food? Who? Tell me their names at once.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP09_006: Do not dismiss the products of civilized society! Blocks are the best!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP09_007: Civilized...? Blocks? Are you talking about those creatures called Elves or something? I do not understand...
Affinity_DianaYester_EP10_001: Sharp horns are a warrior's pride. Are they not magnificent?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP10_003: Indeed. Look at that keen angle. That dignity. Not just anyone can possess horns like these.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP10_004: Still, they look a little dangerous.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP10_005: Are you worried that your height means they might stab you? You are a coward despite your size?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP10_006: Did you sharpen them to make them that pointed?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP10_007: Proper care is only natural, is it not? Of course they are sharp. I honed them myself.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP11_002: Now that is one fierce-looking person!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP11_003: It is not merely my expression. Everything about me is fierce. Why are you suddenly so impressed by that? Hah.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP11_004: I was not looking at you.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP11_005: Of course you were. You kept glancing at me, then whipped your eyes away when ours met. Were you intimidated by me?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP11_006: W-What?! Am I not allowed to look?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP11_007: I was only asking. Why are you suddenly so defensive? Do you have something to hide?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP12_002: You like quiet places? That is unexpected.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP12_003: Why is it unexpected? My dream is to live alone in quiet, languid peace.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP12_004: Come whenever you want to rest somewhere quiet.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP12_005: Good. Training that frustrating Tig already leaves me with a mountain of anger, so I suspect I will make frequent use of this place.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP12_006: Ah, not those words...! You have ruined everything!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP12_007: Wh-Why? Did I say something wrong...? Wait, why is the ground suddenly shaking? What is this rumbling, as though a whole crowd is charging this way...?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP13_003: Nothing. I was simply staring into space. When I do this, every stray thought drifting through my head disappears.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP13_005: ...You think that paltry attempt could startle me? This will not do~ I shall demonstrate how to make someone properly jump out of their skin.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP13_006: In any case, I am sorry for everything.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP13_007: What are you talking about? You serve me food for free, and now you suddenly say you wronged me...? You thought I was glaring at you? Good grief...
Affinity_DianaYester_EP14_001: Do you not find it bothersome when the others come asking for food every time?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP14_002: Not at all. I like that it helps me grow closer to everyone.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP14_003: How curious. I hate people who whine for this and that more than anything. Is that what makes a Master a Master...?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP14_005: I knew it. Then why volunteer for such a nuisance? Since we are discussing it, let us raze this entire place! Then no one can come here.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP14_006: If I say it is bothersome, will you come help every day?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP14_007: What? What did you just ask me to do? Say that again...
Affinity_DianaYester_EP15_001: S-Stop! Do not bring me any more food!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP15_002: Nonsense! I shall repay you in kind!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP15_003: The one who fed the Master until they nearly burst was the village chief! That was not me! Why are you doing this to me?!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP15_004: Really...? You are leaving just like that...? Truly...?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP15_005: Argh, I really am full! Those watery eyes will not change... change... Ugh! I emptied this entire plate already!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP15_006: Is that all you can manage? How disappointing~
Affinity_DianaYester_EP15_007: All?! Did you just say that was all?! Bring me every dish in the Banquet Hall! I shall wipe out the entire supply today!!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP16_001: It is good that no requests reach me here. Do you know how irritating they were?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP16_002: What sort of requests did you receive?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP16_003: Hit someone, teach someone a lesson, all that sort of thing. It was always the same. I grew utterly sick of them.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP16_004: They must have asked because you are so strong.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP16_005: Well, that is only natural. No matter how strong they grew, they could not touch a hair on my body. Ahh~ Being strong can be terribly exhausting sometimes.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP17_001: Even I think my temperament is somewhat rough.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP17_002: Oh? So are you going to try changing it?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP17_003: No. Why would I? This is who I am. If anyone dislikes me this way, they should avoid me.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP17_005: That means you think I have a foul temper too, Master. Hmm, how does my axe look? It seems as though it has quite the temper itself, does it not?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP17_006: Why? Did someone say you have a bad personality?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP17_007: Who would dare say that to me? It is simply my own conclusion. I have never met anyone as rough and unruly as I am.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP18_001: Knowing that I cannot return to my original world is terribly stifling.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP18_003: How could you, Master? Are you especially empathetic, or did you also suddenly fall into this place from a clear blue sky as I did?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP18_004: Since things have come to this, let us make the best of it.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP18_005: It is not very different from where I lived, so adapting should not be difficult... Sigh. Still, I suppose that subtle sense of unfamiliarity cannot be helped.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP18_006: One glass of cold water to wash all that frustration away~
Affinity_DianaYester_EP18_007: ...Thank you. Sometimes a cool glass of water is better than a long string of words meant to comfort someone.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP19_001: I spent every day serving meals. I never thought the day would come when someone served me.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP19_003: Hmph. Do you think there is anything I cannot do? Not one person who ate my cooking ever called it bad. Naturally.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP19_004: I served you today, so next time it is your turn.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP19_005: Grr, who decided that?! It is a nuisance! A complete nuisance!!
Affinity_DianaYester_EP19_007: Eda, where I came from. And now, Tig. She eats remarkably well. It is terribly bothersome, but I also feel rather proud.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP20_001: What? Why are you yawning so much?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP20_002: I am unusually tired today, even though nothing happened.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP20_003: At times like this, a nap in the cabin I favored would leave me refreshed. Ah, my cabin... I wish I could return...
Affinity_DianaYester_EP20_004: I prepared plenty of ingredients, and now I am tired.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP20_005: How could preparing ingredients make you tired? I knew you were weak, but at that level, are you not ill...?
Affinity_DianaYester_EP20_006: I have exhausted the stamina I prepared, so I cannot make any more food.
Affinity_DianaYester_EP20_007: Tch, you cannot remain that weak... This will not do. Follow me! I shall thoroughly rebuild your basic stamina!
